title: Kepler's small stellated dodecahedron as a Riemann surface
note: Pacific J. Math. 220(1) (2005), 167-182. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.2140/pjm.2005.220.167) and MSP open-access text (2026-11-28). Constructs the hyperbolic {5,4} / (2,4,5) triangle-group Riemann surface of Kepler's small stellated dodecahedron (= Bring's genus-4 curve with Aut = S_5, Prop. 2.2 & Sec. 4) and proves geometrically that its Jacobian is isogenous to T^4 for an explicit rhombic elliptic curve T (Theorem 1.1, Corollary 5.5).
